name: doviello_horseman
description: a Doviello Horseman, a wild northern rider wearing a grey wolf-pelt headdress with the wolf's snout over his brow and a shaggy grey-and-white fur cloak over brown leather, long brown hair and blue warpaint on his face, a round hide shield with a blue wolf emblem on his RIGHT arm and a feathered spear with a pale stone point and blue-grey feathers in his LEFT hand, riding a dark-maned bay horse with a brown coat, a near-black mane and tail and dark hooves
hands: the feathered spear stays in the rider's left hand on the screen-right side and the round wolf-emblem shield on his right arm on the screen-left side
